subject: ISV Sell-With credentialing & listing gap assessment
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Menon <rajesh@acme-analytics.com>; Lisa Harper <lisa.harper@amazon.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: ISV Sell-With credentialing & listing gap assessment

Rajesh / Lisa —

Thanks for taking the time today. Following up with a concise ask so we can triage the Sell-With listing and co-sell eligibility across AWS/GCP/Azure. From our side we want to confirm the minimal evidence set and classify gaps so Acme can hit partner marketplace requirements in a single sprint.

Can you please share or confirm the following by EOD Monday:
- Verified legal entity docs and KCD (company registration / tax information) — we usually accept a single consolidated PDF.
- Entitlement matrix: which SKUs / feature flags map to marketplace SKUs (we attached a template).
- Telemetry & metering: list of telemetry events that map to metering metrics and where those are emitted (ingest layer / control plane).
- Any co-sell paperwork or marketplace-specific contract clauses that require signature authority (POC, sales credits, revenue share).

Olga / Ben — can you validate whether the attached entitlement template matches Redwood’s Sell-With mapping? If there are any policy exceptions (e.g., GovCloud / FedRAMP carve-outs) flag them.

Next steps I propose: Acme sends KCD + entitlements sheet; Redwood and AWS/GCP run a 48–72h evidence triage; then we schedule a 30m signoff to queue the listing.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear list. I've attached a single PDF with our corporate KCD and a first-pass entitlement matrix filled against your template. Quick notes:
- Telemetry is emitted from our ingestion service (events: session.start, inference.count, enterprise.feature_flag). We'll add event IDs to the sheet tomorrow.
- We currently do not have a billing-metering shim for Azure; AWS and GCP are covered via our backend.
- On contracts: our legal team requires a standard reseller addendum for revenue share; I can surface the draft if needed.

We expect to have the updated entitlement sheet (with event IDs) and telemetry mapping by end of day tomorrow. If AWS / GCP need additional evidence (SOC2 report, penetration test summary) we can provide redacted versions.

Best —

Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ISV Sell-With credentialing & listing gap assessment

Vivek / Rajesh —

Appreciate the checklist. A couple of clarifications from AWS side:
1) For Sell-With (co-sell) we need a validated seller profile and evidence of sales enablement (playbook, customer references) in addition to the KCD. Two reference accounts that have used the product with vendor-led deployment is the typical ask.
2) The revenue-share addendum is standard — however, signatory level varies by ARR band. If Acme expects to exceed $500k ARR in the first 12 months we may need a Director-level signatory.
3) Metering: AWS prefers a POST-ingest metering endpoint or signed usage reports. If Acme cannot provide a shim for Azure immediately, we can proceed with a GCP/AWS partial listing but must mark Azure as a 'catalog preview' until metering is available.

Happy to join the triage call once you have the updated sheet.

—Lisa
Partner Development Manager, AWS Marketplace
lisa.harper@amazon.com

All — quick operational notes from Redwood Ops side after a skim of Acme's attachments:
- Olga: the entitlement mapping looks sane; I'll slot it for a deeper review but top-level SKU mapping aligns with our Sell-With transform.
- Metering gap for Azure: we should propose a temporary workaround — prefix-based usage attribution plus a scheduled signed usage file (daily CSV) until a proper meter is implemented. That will satisfy Azure catalog intake for a preview listing.
- Evidence: request a redacted SOC2 Type II report and the latest pen-test summary (as Rajesh offered). We can accept redacted versions under NDA.

Action items:
- Rajesh: please upload the telemetry event IDs and the redacted SOC2 to the shared drive link Vivek included.
- Olga: can you produce a one-page mapping doc that shows how Acme events map to Redwood usage tokens? That will speed approval.

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Ecosystem Ops, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the rapid turnaround. I reviewed your entitlement sheet and drafted the mapping doc (attached) that ties Acme telemetry events to Redwood tokenization and listing SKUs. Two small asks before I hand this to marketplace intake:
1) Add the event schema (JSON examples) for session.start and inference.count — I used placeholder fields but need concrete event names/keys.
2) Confirm which org email will be the billing contact and which email will be the signatory for marketplace contracts.

If you can drop the event JSON and confirm contacts in the shared Google Sheet, I will package everything for AWS/GCP intake and request co-sell enablement. We can then schedule the 30m triage on Monday at 10am PT.
